evidence_layer: compiled source, configuration, ELF symbols and disassembly; no hardware execution

startup.normal_startup_gate: verified for the pinned healthy application startup sequence
startup.phase_storage: DRAM, constant initialized; binding constructor does not reset it
ordering_evidence: cpu_start.c:261-285: CPU1 completes console setup and startup logging before setting s_cpu_inited[1].
cpu_start.c:287-289: CPU1 parks until s_resume_cores; only ROM delay runs on the normal waiting path.
cpu_start.c:930-940 and 1007-1008: CPU0 waits for both initialized flags before SYS_STARTUP_FN.
startup.c:177-184: CORE callbacks execute before C++ constructors.
startup.c:145-155 and 190: other cores resume only for the later secondary stage.
The first linked CORE record installs quarantine while prior normal ROM output calls have returned and CPU1 is parked.
startup.constructor_audit: Initializes only adapter and writer; no writes to phase, receipt_enabled or receipt deadline state.

receipt_path.absolute_deadline_admission: available checks owned state and original absolute deadline plus clock regression; writable, write_one, flush and pause call it before MMIO/delay
receipt_path.pause: ROM delay capped at min(5 microseconds, original remaining budget)
receipt_path.scope: Receipt output bypasses FILE and SDK logging. This is not a claim that all firmware code is free of libc locks.

readiness_gate.disabled_path: Owned but not enabled returns at 0x42006e83 before timer, formatter or FIFO access. Quarantine output still faults.
readiness_gate.admission: Generated handle_ready calls begin_session at line 745 only after challenge syntax, self-test, radio-ready, idle and zero-counter checks.
readiness_gate.command_gate: Generated CLI line 768 suppresses all non-ready commands before session start.
readiness_gate.receive_gate: Generated RX loop lines 888-892 skips processing before session start without clearing a pending IRQ.
readiness_gate.repeat_enable: Idempotent while healthy; it does not reset a fault.

exception_boundaries: Panic direct USB FIFO writer remains live at 0x4202320c; panic and reset terminate the accepted normal session.
ROM-internal exceptional output is not universally intercepted by ELF wrappers.
A callback already admitted before asynchronous invalidation or deadline passage may finish; this is not instantaneous cancellation.
FIFO acceptance and terminal ZLP handoff do not prove host application delivery.
No physical USB timing, radio result, physical radio idle, or flash authorization follows from this audit.
